signature.composition: large red scissors cutting through horizontal navy tag

prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for destroying a tag. Draw a LARGE horizontal dark navy tag with one large white circular hole on its left end. Across the right end, show a LARGE RED PAIR OF SCISSORS cutting through the tag; scissors have two oversized round finger holes and two short thick blades. A clean white gap splits off the cut end. Make the tag, scissors and cut gap clear at 30x18 pixels. No lightning, no plus, no words or shadows; all artwork fits within the central 70 percent of the square canvas with wide white margins.
